brand.name: Erbology
brand.one_line_description: Organic, cold-pressed hemp seed oil in light-protecting amber glass, made for a simple daily body-balance ritual.
brand.mission: To make plant-based daily wellness simple enough that anyone can read the label once and know exactly what they're putting in their body.
brand.vision: In five years, Erbology is the single-ingredient plant oil people reach for by default, and the one they recommend without needing to explain it.
core_values: Small daily rituals over big promises
brand.positioning_statement: For people who want one simple, plant-based addition to their daily routine, Erbology Hemp Seed Oil is the organic, cold-pressed oil that says exactly what it is, because a wellness product shouldn't need a glossary.
competitors: CBD wellness oils (shelf neighbours, often confused with hemp seed oil)
brand.differentiation: A single-ingredient hemp seed oil presented with apothecary-modern restraint: amber glass to protect the oil, a label that names the ingredient and process plainly, and a hemp leaf used as botanical illustration rather than a lifestyle signal.

product.name: Erbology Hemp Seed Oil (Body Balance)
product.description: A 200mL (6.8 fl oz) bottle of organic, cold-pressed hemp seed oil in amber glass with a black screw cap, positioned under the Body Balance banner. Intended for daily use as a finishing oil or simple wellness addition. It is both edible and topical. Recommended serving: 1 teaspoon.
key_features: Organic, cold-pressed hemp seed oil, with a single ingredient named on the label. No additives or blends.
Amber glass bottle protects the oil from light
Front label shows ingredient, process, range and volume (200mL / 6.8 fl oz) at a glance
top_benefits: A simple, single-ingredient source of plant-based omega-3 and omega-6 fats. Lab tested.
A nutty, green flavour that works drizzled over salads, yoghurt, or smoothies
One bottle, one ingredient, no label to decode
product.proof_points: Organic certified by OSA. Licence number: 1234567890. Lab tested for less than 1% THC. Fatty-acid profile (ALA:LA ratio) is 6:1. Press date and batch number available on every bottle.
product.category: Most people currently choose between everyday cooking oils, fish-oil or omega supplements, and CBD oils, and are unsure where hemp seed oil fits, or that it comes from the seed and is not CBD oil.

audience.primary_audience: Health-conscious adults, 25-45, who already buy premium oils or take a daily supplement and read ingredient labels out of habit.
audience.demographics: Urban and inner-suburb dwellers, college-educated, mid-to-upper household income, shopping at natural food stores, specialty grocers, and online.
audience.psychographics: Values purity and clarity over trends; skeptical of miracle claims and detox language; drawn to minimal, apothecary-style design; will pay a premium for organic and cold-pressed if the difference is explained.
pain_points: Unsure how hemp seed oil differs from CBD oil, and wary of the cannabis association
Tired of wellness products with long ingredient lists and vague promises
Doesn't know how to use a specialty oil day to day, so it sits unopened
audience.desired_outcome: Feeling like they've added one simple, trustworthy thing to their routine, without having to research fatty acids or decode a label.
channels: natural food stores and specialty grocers
audience.objections: Price is higher than olive or flax oil; confusion with cannabis or CBD products and questions about THC; unsure of the taste; unrefined hemp oil is not suited to high-heat cooking, and people don't know how else to use it.
audience.secondary_audience: Independent wellness retailers, natural grocers, and practitioners looking for a clearly labeled, single-ingredient plant oil to stock or recommend.

we_are: Specific about what is in the bottle and how it was made
Careful with health claims: we describe the oil, we don't promise outcomes
Written like a knowledgeable friend, not a wellness guru
we_are_not: Leaning on cannabis puns or 'high' wordplay
Mystical or vague about what 'balance' means

avoid: CBD (except to clarify that this is not CBD oil)

tone.example_line: Organic hemp seeds, cold-pressed. Nothing else in the bottle.

offer.core_offer: 15% off your first 200mL bottle, with a simple usage card in the box.
offer.pricing_packaging: One 200mL (6.8 fl oz) amber glass bottle at $25; consider a 2-bottle bundle and an optional subscription every 6-8 weeks. At one teaspoon (5mL) a day, a bottle lasts about 40 days.
offer.urgency_reason: Deliberately none, in keeping with the calm brand voice. If a reason to act is needed: oil is best used within its recommended window after opening, so we suggest one bottle at a time rather than stocking up.
offer.guarantee: Full refund on your first bottle within 30 days if it isn't what you expected.
offer.post_conversion: Welcome email explains what hemp seed oil is (and that it is not CBD oil), three easy ways to use it, how to store it, and when to reorder.
